options.content: UNAS is now the shared storage dependency for Home Assistant music, Plex/media libraries, Arr imports, qBittorrent/SAB downloads, Immich photos, Garage object data, and the primary VolSync Kopia repository. Use the top row first: exporter reachability, RAID/SMART health, pool pressure, NFS server pressure, and whether the NVMe write-back cache is helping or accumulating dirty data.
